title: Gnocaxtitto Gnacaxtitta
description: A Caxton Resource Pack for modded minecraft adding Adwaita Mono as the font
body:
# Gnocaxtitto Gnacaxtitta

A Font Pack intended to change the font to Adwaitia Mono Font

It only works with [Caxton](https://modrinth.com/mod/caxton) installed in Modded Minecraft.

The Gallery includes Screenshots of the game displaying the game's text in that font.
